title: Emulator Overlay Engine Semantic Event Envelope
description: Domain-neutral shape for a semantic event derived from consecutive normalized-state snapshots (ADR 0013). A domain package (e.g. src/domains/pokemon) owns the interpretation that produces events in this shape; this schema owns only the shape itself and knows nothing about any specific domain.

type.description: Dotted semantic event type, owned and namespaced by the producing domain (e.g. "pokemon.fainted"). Not enumerated here - domains may add event types without a platform schema change.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing integer assigned at detection time, unique within one session's sequencer. Guarantees a stable total order even when multiple events share the same detectedAt value (e.g. several events detected from the same snapshot pair).

detectedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp assigned at detection time. This is wall-clock detection time, not necessarily in-game time - it has no defined relationship to any emulator frame counter.

subject.description: Reference to the entity this event is about, where a single entity applies (e.g. a specific party Pokemon). Null for events that are not about one specific entity (e.g. a party-membership change). Domain-defined shape.

previous.description: Relevant previous value(s) this event's transition is from, where applicable. Domain-defined shape. Null when there is no meaningful prior value (e.g. a value that newly became available).

current.description: Relevant current value(s) this event's transition is to, where applicable. Domain-defined shape. Null when there is no meaningful current value (e.g. a value that stopped being available).

provenance.description: Where this event's semantic interpretation came from.

domain.description: The domain package id that produced this event (e.g. "pokemon").

detector.description: The specific detector within that domain that produced this event. Often equal to `type`, but kept distinct since one detector may emit more than one event type (e.g. the HP detector emits hp.changed and, conditionally, damaged/healed).

game.description: Optional game/provider identity the source state carried, for cross-checking which game session this event came from. Not required - not every normalized state includes it.
